description: Renovate is scoped to the vertical-pod-autoscaler project only; the rest of the repository is handled by Dependabot.

packageRules.description: Only update Go dependencies to versions compatible with the module's Go version.
Go modules: also update indirect dependencies (Dependabot dependency-type: all).
k8s.io/kube-openapi and friends are untagged and must track the k8s.io/apimachinery release; don't bump their digests independently. Must come after the indirect enable rule above.
github.com/euank/go-kmsg-parser's v2.0.1 tag ships a go.mod without the /v2 module path, so Go rejects it; stay on v2.0.0+incompatible until upstream fixes their tagging.

Pre-modules +incompatible pseudo-versions cannot follow newer commits once upstream adds a go.mod with a /vN module path (e.g. github.com/mistifyio/go-zfs -> /v4); the importing dependency has to make that move.
k8s.io/client-go only has legacy vN tags above v0.x (v11.0.0+incompatible); never propose them.
Indirect Go modules cannot be moved to a new major (module path) by us; the importing dependency has to do that.
master: group Kubernetes Go modules together.
master: group all other Go modules together.
master: check Dockerfile base images daily and group non-major bumps.
Release branches: Renovate normally offers only the highest non-major version; splitting patch from minor makes it also offer the highest patch when the minor is blocked.
Release branches: no major, minor or digest updates by default; digests track untagged default-branch commits, which are never patch-level.
Release branches: golang.org/x modules are permanently pre-1.0 and treat minor bumps as patch-level, so allow those.

Release branches: k8s.io/kubernetes requires its staging modules at v0.0.0 via replace directives, so Go cannot keep them in lockstep; its tag also appears before the staging modules are published. Bump it manually together with k8s.io/api, apimachinery, client-go, etc.
Release branches: everything that is still enabled goes into a single PR.
Keep fsnotify at or below 1.9.0 to match the restriction in vertical-pod-autoscaler/.golangci.yaml.
